# CoulombPseudopotentials

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/CoulombPseudopotentials`

Manual: [CoulombPseudopotentials (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/CoulombPseudopotentials.md)

```text
CoulombPseudopotentials, version 0.01

Usage: CoulombPseudopotentials [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -l, --landau-level : index of the Landau level (0 for the lowest Landau level) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 0)
    -s, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (i.e. twice the maximum momentum for a single particle) (default value = 8)
    --add-impurities : add two impurities (one at each pole)
    --north-potential : potential associated to the impurity at the north pole (default value = 0)
    --south-potential : potential associated to the impurity at the south pole (default value = 0)
    --north-charge : potential associated to the a charge at the given distance above the north pole
    --south-charge : potential associated to the a charge at the given distance above the south pole
    --relativistic-fermions : assume relativistic fermions
    --graphene-bilayer : calculate pseudopotentials for bilayer graphene (need to specify the four Landau level indices)
    --l1 : Landau level index for graphene bilayer pseudopotentials, can be 0 (LLL) or 1 (1st LL) (default value = 0)
    --l2 : Landau level index for graphene bilayer pseudopotentials, can be 0 (LLL) or 1 (1st LL) (default value = 0)
    --l3 : Landau level index for graphene bilayer pseudopotentials, can be 0 (LLL) or 1 (1st LL) (default value = 0)
    --l4 : Landau level index for graphene bilayer pseudopotentials, can be 0 (LLL) or 1 (1st LL) (default value = 0)
    -d, --layer-separation : assume finite layer separation (default value = 0)
    -t, --layer-thickness : assume finite layer thickness (default value = 0)
    --rescale : rescale separation and thickness for a particular number of particles, filling factor and shift (4 arguments N,p,q,Sigma)
    --manual-scale : scale all terms with a given prefactor (default value = 1)
    --profile-type : type of density-profile (1=infiniteWell, 2=Fang-Howard, 3=infiniteWellExc)
    --other-profile : type of density-profile for second layer (1=infiniteWell, 2=Fang-Howard, 3=infiniteWellExc)
    --profile-points : number of points where profile is evaluated (default value = 200)
    --profile-multiplier : multiplier for number of integration points (default value = 1)
    --tolerance : relative tolerance to be achieved in numerical integrations (default value = 1e-08)
    --no-interpolation : do not use interpolation for finite width calculations
    -n, --nbody : add n-body potentials
    -p, --nbody-potentials : values of n-body potentials to be added (separated by ','
    -v, --add-v0 : add some amount to v_0 (default value = 0)
    -w, --add-v1 : add some amount to v_1 (default value = 0)
    -k, --kappa : add three-body terms for Landau-level mixing according to Bishara-Nayak (default value = 0)
    --BN-only : include Landau-level mixing terms, only
    --tab : output a table with the results in columns (extension .tab)
    -o, --output : output file name (default is pseudopotential_coulomb_l_x_2s_y[_v_xxx_w_yyy].dat)
    --std-output : use standard output instead of an output file

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
